pending-release-overwrite.help: Use verified XKB detectable autorepeat and forward every key release in order.
pending-release-overwrite.message: Preserve the first X11 key-release event instead of overwriting pending release state.

repeat-timing-heuristic.help: Use verified XKB detectable autorepeat instead of inferring physical releases from event timing.
repeat-timing-heuristic.message: Synthetic repeat pairs can cross polling batches; timing cannot reliably identify physical releases.
